prompt: Add a `--limit <n>` flag to `celis grep`: it prints at most n of the lines found, then one line that says how many it left out.
Let `celis names` take `--json`: one JSON object a line for each name, with the name, the id of its trail and its project.
Make `celis step add --at <place>` refuse a place that is an absolute path outside the project's top folder, as a usage error that names the place.
Make `celis tree --all` show at most 20 trails a day, newest first, and then one line that says how many trails of that day it left out.
Add a section to CONTRIBUTING.md that tells a contributor how to add a new eval case under evals/, with the files a case needs, and an example.
Add a `--since <yyyy-mm-dd>` flag to `celis grep` that keeps only the lines of that day or later.
Make `celis rules --json` give each rule's trigger too, as the decision json of `step start --json` does.
Add a pinned rule: `celis decide --pinned` writes the label `["l", "pinned", "celis.decision"]`, and `celis rules` prints pinned rules first. Write it into the spec first.
The type `Given` in crates/celis/src/command/rules/given.rs is named after what it does. Give it a better name and update every use.
Add unit tests for crates/celis/src/command/rules/index.rs: the counts of words, the words it leaves out, and the wrap of long lines.
Tell the agent in the plugin card what to do when a celis command prints that celis is older than its plugin.
Add `celis tree --project <name>`: it shows only the trails of that project.
Make `celis decide` refuse a rule whose text does not start with "When ", as a usage error that shows the form "When X: do Y, because Z".
Describe `celis rules` and its index of words in README.md, for a person who installs celis.
Make `celis stats` print one plain line when the store holds no record, in place of empty tables.
